mods.name: All Items by OPNiki

mods.name: Auto Sprint+
mods.works: Sprints for you while you walk forward, and always draws a box at the top left (gui 10,10, 190x26) saying 'Sprint: Toggled'; the box hides with the GUI (F1), as its code checks Hud.isHidden.
mods.note: From Modrinth, unchanged. Not yet: its settings screen and HUD editor (key Y) don't open; its toggle key has no default; the check uses F1 hiding its always-on box, so it assumes F1 hides the GUI in Horizon; the mod works without it

mods.note: From Modrinth, unchanged. Not yet: its colour/depth settings screen doesn't exist without Mod Menu/Cloth; nothing else missing; the mod works without it

mods.name: SprintByDefault

mods.note: From Modrinth, unchanged. Not yet: The sprinting itself isn't checked on screen; the try checks the command's own state replies; the mod works without it
